actions.description: Pipettes are hanging on rack; gloved hand reaches for rightmost yellow-coded pipette.
Pipette is removed from rack and moved toward bench/tip area.
Pipette is positioned over a red-lidded tip box; a tip appears to be attached/pressed onto the pipette.
Pipette tip is held in/near the tip box area; no clear aspiration or dispensing from a sample is visible.
Pipette is moved back toward the rack with tip still attached.
Pipette is returned to the rack.

reuse.evidence: No transfer between different samples/reagents is visible; only tip pickup and return to rack are shown.

surface.evidence: The tip is not visibly touching the bench, glove, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface before use.

release.evidence: No tip drop/ejection or unexpected release is visible.

install.evidence: The visible tip appears seated on the pipette; no wrong-size or poorly fitted tip is apparent.

output.overall_summary: The clip shows selecting a pipette, attaching a tip from a tip box, and returning the pipette to the rack. No visible technique error is more likely than not.
